name: implement-fix
description: The fix subflow invoked by bug-triage-fix once a reproducible bug has a ticket: plan the smallest correct change, implement it, verify with a regression test, then review before it ships.

phases.name: plan
implement
verify
phases.prompt: Verify the fix resolves the bug and that the regression test passes. Report pass/fail with evidence.

phases.name: review
phases.prompt: Review the change for correctness and regressions before it ships.
